statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH (yellow). Tail holds in the watch band and edges up to 22 because NQ has extended to a new session low after a completed retracement failed, with VIX now above Thursday's close, while conflicting index breadth and a sub-15 volatility level keep it well below the block threshold.
recommendation: Conditions are described as a chip-led rotation inside a still-live post-Jackson-Hole repricing rather than a broad index de-rating, with residual conditional risk concentrated in the narrow 17:00Z-20:00Z window ahead of the 21:00Z weekend futures halt. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain active throughout.
headline: NQ fails its post-Warsh retracement a second time and extends to new session lows as hike odds reach 60% and Chicago PMI sinks to 47.1, nudging Tail to 22 while the broad tape stays orderly
body:
The post-keynote whipsaw has resolved lower for a second time. NQ futures trade at 29,476.25, -0.74%, after printing a new session low at 29,436.75; earlier in the session the contract had recovered the entire post-speech decline to reach 29,811.50 before failing there. The Nasdaq-100 cash index is 29,408.98, -0.78% from Thursday's 29,641.56 close, inside a 29,383.92-29,752.78 range and sitting close to its own low. A retracement that completes and then fails, followed by extension to a new extreme, is the specific structure that matters for this measure, and it is why Tail moves from 20 to 22.

The catalyst stack has also become internally consistent in an unhelpful way. Chairman Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote said the Fed has "work to do" on inflation, with PCE at 3.7% over twelve months, and September hike odds repriced from roughly 35% to about 60%. The 2-year yield is 4.35%, up about 11 basis points, against a 10-year at 4.73%, up roughly 5 - a bear flattener that pressures long-duration technology valuations directly. Separately, the August Chicago Business Barometer printed 47.1 against a 58.3 consensus, its steepest drop since December 2025, with new orders down 15.4 points while the prices component reached its highest level since February 2022. Hawkish policy alongside a weakening growth signal is a harder combination for the index than either alone.

Two things keep Tail inside the watch band rather than moving it toward the block threshold. First, this remains a concentrated rotation: the PHLX Semiconductor Index is 11,468.76, -3.48%, and Nvidia is 218.74, -4.05%, while the S&P 500 is only -0.31% and the Dow is close to flat. Index-wide liquidation looks different from a chip-led leg with the broad tape intact, and conflicting breadth of this kind normally belongs in Stress. Second, the volatility surface is confirming only mildly. VIX at 14.81 is above Thursday's 14.51 close and near its 14.84 session high, which is a genuine change from the prior hour, but an absolute level under 15 is not the signature of a market denying mean reversion.

Stress rises to 64 to carry the hawkish repricing, the stagflationary tone of the Chicago print and the severity of the semiconductor move. The danger window is drawn narrowly around 17:00Z-20:00Z: the live extension and the U.S. closing auction sit inside it, and beyond 20:00Z only one thin futures hour remains before the Globex weekend halt at 21:00Z, which mechanically limits how far any one-way path can run from here.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours the assessment ran from EA_ON into the watch band. Tail sat between 11 and 14 through Thursday's late session and the overnight, with the mode consistently mixed and Stress drifting up from 49 to 55 as the 14:00Z Jackson Hole keynote approached. Tail rose to 13 at 13:00Z and 17 at 14:00Z as the speech printed and the first session low was set, eased to 14 at 15:00Z on an apparently completed recovery, then stepped to 20 at 16:00Z when that recovery failed and the mode turned to event/whipsaw. One hour, 10:00Z, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The horizon has three phases. The current 17:00Z hour carries the highest reading of the set at 22, with the 18:00Z and 19:00Z hours defining the rest of the narrow 17:00Z-20:00Z danger window: whether the 29,436.75 futures low holds is the open question, and the 19:00Z power hour keeps a one-point structural step for closing-auction and pre-weekend flow ahead of Monday's month-end turn. From 20:00Z the cash session is closed and only one thin futures hour remains, so conditional Tail falls back under the watch band. From the 21:00Z Globex weekend halt to the end of the horizon no venue is open, conditional Tail collapses to a weekend residual and Confidence decays with distance from the last observed evidence; the next real price path arrives at the Sunday 22:00Z reopen, outside this horizon.

forecast.analysis: Observed now: NQ has extended to a new session low at 29,436.75 after fully retracing the post-keynote decline to 29,811.50 and failing there; cash NDX is 29,408.98, -0.78%, near its 29,383.92 low. VIX has flipped above Thursday's close to 14.81. That failed retracement plus the extension is why Tail steps to 22.
